source_evidence: If you have a problem with your investments, investment account, or a financial professional, use our investor complaint form to provide us your information.
answer: If you have a problem involving your investments, investment account, or financial professional, you can submit your information using the SEC’s investor complaint form. For a question or a request for information, use the investor question form instead. You can also call the SEC’s free help line at 1-800-732-0330 or email Help@SEC.gov.
